The '''Crossroads''' was the name given by [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] to a junction of three tracks on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. While there were no true roads on Mustafar, the Crossroads was located at the intersection of pathways connecting the safe [[Mining Fields]] to the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]] and other dangerous area of Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:TCFM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crossroads was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crossroads was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TCFM" />
